\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 238-241 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R246-first-pass-words-from-chapters-238-241}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a painter and music.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item beyond, on this side, at the house of, face to face, by which way
  \item at the same time, perhaps, also, as if, because of
  \item rough, deep, unknown, necessary, useless
  \item industrious, talkative, worried, unmarried, rainy
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Beyond? (\textbf{ultrā}.) On this side? (\textbf{citrā}.) At the house of? (\textbf{apud}.) Face to face? (\textbf{cōram}.) By which way? (\textbf{quā}.) At the same time? (\textbf{simul}.) Perhaps? (\textbf{fortasse}.) Also? (\textbf{quoque}.) As if? (\textbf{quasi}.) Because of? (\textbf{propter}.) Rough? (\textbf{asper, aspera, asperum}.) Deep? (\textbf{profundus, profunda, profundum}.) Unknown? (\textbf{ignōtus, ignōta, ignōtum}.) Necessary? (\textbf{necessārius, necessāria, necessārium}.) Useless? (\textbf{inūtilis, inūtile}.) Industrious? (\textbf{industrius, industria, industrium}.) Talkative? (\textbf{loquāx, loquācis}.) Worried? (\textbf{sollicitus, sollicita, sollicitum}.) Unmarried? (\textbf{caelebs, caelibis}.) Rainy? (\textbf{pluvius, pluvia, pluvium}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 242-246 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R246-second-pass-words-from-chapters-242-246}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for few and all.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item few, all, whole, the others, other
  \item doubtful, faithful, loyal, unlucky, blessed
  \item a travelling carriage, a broad street, an aqueduct, the public baths, an amphitheatre
  \item a thief, a robber, a consul, a general, a kingdom
  \item a song, a line of verse, a writer, a painter, music
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Few? (\textbf{paucī, paucae, pauca}.) All? (\textbf{omnis, omne}.) Whole? (\textbf{tōtus, tōta, tōtum}.) The others? (\textbf{cēterī, cēterae, cētera}.) Other? (\textbf{alius, alia, aliud}.) Doubtful? (\textbf{dubius, dubia, dubium}.) Faithful? (\textbf{fīdus, fīda, fīdum}.) Loyal? (\textbf{fīdēlis, fīdēle}.) Unlucky? (\textbf{īnfēlīx, īnfēlīcis}.) Blessed? (\textbf{beātus, beāta, beātum}.) A travelling carriage? (\textbf{raeda, raedae}.) A broad street? (\textbf{platēa, platēae}.) An aqueduct? (\textbf{aquaeductus, aquaeductūs}.) The public baths? (\textbf{thermae, thermārum}.) An amphitheatre? (\textbf{amphitheātrum, amphitheātrī}.) A thief? (\textbf{fūr, fūris}.) A robber? (\textbf{latrō, latrōnis}.) A consul? (\textbf{cōnsul, cōnsulis}.) A general? (\textbf{imperātor, imperātōris}.) A kingdom? (\textbf{rēgnum, rēgnī}.) A song? (\textbf{carmen, carminis}.) A line of verse? (\textbf{versus, versūs}.) A writer? (\textbf{scrīptor, scrīptōris}.) A painter? (\textbf{pictor, pictōris}.) Music? (\textbf{mūsica, mūsicae}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
